Canvas: Frank — kitchen, morning (scene_kitchen_with_frank_morning) | Node: Kitchen — Frank, morning




Frank had the paper open at the table when she came in. He didn't look up. The kettle was already cool — Diana's pour, an hour ago, before she'd gone out to the garden. Coffee bitter from sitting since five-thirty.

Frank: Morning.

He folded the corner of the page when she sat. He went back to the page. The clock above the stove was the loudest thing in the kitchen.









Pour your coffee.

Frank passes you in the hallway. Coffee mug in his hand, the chipped one with the boat on it. He nods.

Frank: Lights left on in the living room.

You stand there a second.

Frank: I got it.

He keeps walking. The kitchen door swings shut behind him.

Canvas: Kitchen — Frank, coffee alone (scene_kitchen_frank_coffee_alone) | Node: Kitchen — Frank, coffee alone




The kitchen is dim. Frank at the counter, mug in hand. He glances over his shoulder when you come in.

Frank: You're up.

He nods at the pot. You pour a cup.

Frank: Couldn't sleep?
You: Just woke up early.
Frank: Mm.

He drinks. The two of you stand at the counter, the kitchen quiet around you.
